(1) no trade is possible under heterogeneous priors and (2) if at least one of the two parties to trade has some probability on the other being irrational, then trade is possible.
(i) no trade occurs under heterogeneous priors, and (ii) yes trade occurs under heterogeneous p-beliefs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
trade is not necessarily a sign of common priors, but it can be a sign of common p-beliefs.
